_comment: Advisory course-substitution (petition) examples. These are NOT official same-course equivalences and never receive automatic requirement credit. MIT EECS handles every departmental petition case by case; students must consult their advisor and submit through the department audit. Official catalog equivalent_subjects / old_id values are handled separately and do receive automatic equivalence credit.

substitutions.note: Advisory comparison only. The catalog lists 6.1220, which itself requires 6.1210, as a prerequisite for 6.5210; no blanket substitution is documented. Ask an advisor and submit a departmental petition for an individual decision.
